title: Simba JDBC Driver (Legacy) 2.8.6 is available
body: Simba JDBC Driver (Legacy) 2.8.6 prevents pending Cloud Fetch downloads from delaying the last connection from closing. It also updates `lz4-java`, Jackson, and `libthrift`. Download it from the [JDBC drivers archive](https://www.databricks.com/spark/jdbc-drivers-archive) under **All JDBC Driver Versions (Simba)**.
